about: Software Engineer specializing in backend architecture, RESTful API design, and AI integrations. Experienced in optimizing data pipelines, building scalable web systems, and deploying machine learning models across edge devices.

description: Evaluated and validated cutting-edge research papers by engineering simulation testbeds utilizing TensorFlow, PyTorch, Flower AI, and MATLAB.
Spearheaded testing workflows for FedCO, an optimization project involving distributed Federated Learning and edge Computational Offloading mechanisms.
Leveraged Advanced GenAI prompting models and structural analytical techniques to compress discovery lifecycles for edge UAV surveillance configurations.
Architected, debugged, and optimized clean, highly performant production RESTful API workflows utilizing Python, Django, and Django REST Framework.
Engineered resilient, multi-threaded site scrapers and complex data pipelines using Playwright, Selenium, BeautifulSoup, and scheduled task management via Celery-Beats.
Drove web scraper target data success rate up to 90% reliability by implementing custom network request interception models, defeating anti-bot blocks.

projects.name: Blood Network
